snippet.title: Sortilège | Official Trailer | Tactical Dice Duels EN
snippet.description:
Sortilège | a tactical dice duel between rivals.

A handful of dice. Every roll is a decision. Roll, read
the table, and commit,  but your opponent is doing the same thing.
No grinding, no filler. Just sharp reads and sharper plays.

FEATURES
• Singleplayer campaign with 5 distinct AI opponents
• Online multiplayer - share a lobby code, no account needed
• Boon drafts: level up mid-match and upgrade your dice
• Matches that play out in minutes, not hours
• Gamepad + keyboard & mouse support

LINKS
Wishlist on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4765500/Sortilege/
Play on itch.io: https://maple-leaf-makers.itch.io/sortilege
